sourcedFrom: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) (2025)
cleanIntro: Staccato's own owner's manual for the 2011 HD pistols, followed in Staccato's order and no further. The book is written for the whole HD line and never names the C3.6. Staccato's customer support has said in writing that it is the owner's manual for the HD line, and the book says it is for the 2011 HD pistols only. ⛔ THIS IS NOT THE STRIP FOR THE OLDER STACCATO P, C2, XC OR XL. On the HD the recoil spring assembly lifts up out of the slide and the reverse plug comes out after it, and there are TWO slide stop levers, one on each side. ⛔ Staccato's line is drawn on p.30: nothing past this field strip at owner level. Anything further is for a Staccato 2011-Certified Armorer, and doing it yourself voids the warranty.

steps.title: Check this is an HD pistol — this book covers the HD only
steps.action: Before following anything below, confirm your pistol is a Staccato HD. The C3.6 is the compact model in the HD line. This guide follows Staccato's HD owner's manual, and the manual says on its first page that it is not for any other 2011.
steps.prose: ⛔ The older Staccato 2011s (the P, C2, XC and XL) come apart differently and are taught from a different book. Their recoil systems are taken out with a paper-clip hook, a take-down tool or a lever. On the HD the recoil spring assembly lifts straight up out of the slide with nothing to hold it captive, and the frame carries a slide stop lever on each side. If that is not your pistol, stop and find the right guide.
steps.quote: This manual is for the 2011 HD pistols only and is not appropriate for use with other 2011 pistols.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — Owner's manual, cover warning, p.1

steps.title: Magazine out first
steps.action: Muzzle in a safe direction, finger off the trigger and outside the guard. Press the magazine catch and remove the magazine. Then take every live round off the bench and out of the room you are working in.
steps.prose: Staccato says to follow the unloading steps in the proper order, and the magazine always comes out first so the slide cannot feed a fresh round while you work it. Live ammunition stays away from the bench for a second reason too: solvent and oil get into primers and powder.
steps.quote: Remove the magazine by pressing the magazine catch (Picture 12).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 1, p.28
steps.warn: Remove any live ammunition and unload all magazines from the area before disassembling your Staccato 2011 HD pistol to minimize the risk of a negligent discharge.

steps.title: Slide fully back to eject, then lock it open
steps.action: Firing hand on the grip, finger outside the guard. Grasp the slide at the rear serrations and pull it fully rearward to eject any round in the chamber. Then push UP on the slide stop lever while easing the slide forward until it locks open.
steps.prose: Pull the slide all the way back. A short pull can leave a round in the chamber that the extractor never reached. The slide stop lever is pushed up before the slide is let forward, not grabbed at afterwards.
steps.quote: Lock the slide in the rearward position by pushing up on the slide stop lever while slowly releasing the slide from the fully rearward position until it locks open.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), steps 2–3, p.28

steps.title: Look AND feel: chamber and magazine well
steps.action: With the slide locked back, look into the chamber and the magazine well, then check both with your finger. No round and no case in either.
steps.prose: ⛔ State Compliant HD pistols have a loaded chamber indicator and a magazine disconnect. Staccato says not to trust either one, or your memory. They are mechanical and can fail. On a Regular HD a chambered round fires whether a magazine is in or not. Either way, only the look and the finger count.
steps.quote: When the slide is locked to the rear, visually (Picture 14) and physically (with your finger) inspect the chamber and the magazine well of the pistol ensuring that no ammunition is left in either (Pictures 14-15).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 4, p.28
steps.warn: Never rely on a magazine disconnect.

steps.title: Slide forward again, and safety glasses on
steps.action: Release the slide: press the slide stop lever down, or pull the slide fully back and let it go. It returns to the fully forward position. Put safety glasses on before the strip begins.
steps.prose: The strip starts from slide-forward, and the next step brings it back to a precise point. Staccato asks for safety glasses for the whole strip because the recoil spring assembly is under load.
steps.quote: Release the slide by either pressing the slide stop lever down to release it, allowing the slide to return to the fully forward position
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 5, p.28
steps.warn: To protect your eyes from serious injury that can be caused by components that are under pressure such as springs, always wear safety glasses when disassembling your Staccato 2011 HD pistol.

steps.title: Pull the slide back to the TAKEDOWN notch and hold it
steps.action: Firing hand on the grip, finger outside the guard. With the other hand at the rear serrations, pull the slide back until the takedown notch lines up with the slide stop lever. Hold it there through the next two steps.
steps.prose: This is a partial pull to one exact point, not a full stroke. The slide stop lever only comes out at this one position. Anywhere else it is held by the slide.
steps.quote: Hold your Staccato 2011 HD pistol with your firing hand with on the grip and your finger off the trigger and outside the trigger guard, grasp the rear of the slide at the serrations and pull it back until the takedown notch is aligned with the slide stop lever (Picture 17).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 6, p.29

steps.title: Press the strong-side slide stop lever out of the frame
steps.action: With your trigger finger, press on the end of the strong-side slide stop lever where it comes through the frame, and push it out. A small pin punch can help if it is tight.
steps.prose: It only moves while the slide is held at the takedown notch. If it will not start, check the notch is still aligned before pressing harder. Staccato's suggestion for a tight one is a small pin punch, which will not slip and mark the frame the way a screwdriver blade can.
steps.quote: strong side slide stop lever out of the frame (Picture 18) (Note: If needed a small tool such as a pin punch or similar can help press the slide stop lever out.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 7, p.29

steps.title: Pull the strong-side lever clear, slide still held back
steps.action: Keep holding the slide at the notch. With the thumb and index finger of your non-firing hand, take hold of the strong-side slide stop lever and draw it out of the frame.
steps.prose: Keep holding the slide back until the lever is fully out. If the slide drifts off the notch while the lever is half out, it binds and you have to realign before it will move again.
steps.quote: While continuing to hold the slide in the rearward position, use the thumb and index finger of your nonfiring hand, to grab the strong side slide stop lever and remove it from the frame (Picture 19).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 8, p.29

steps.title: Ease the slide forward off the frame
steps.action: With the lever out, let the slide move forward slowly against the recoil spring, then pull it forward off the front of the frame.
steps.prose: Let it go forward slowly under control. The recoil spring is still pushing on it, and a slide that is released all at once leaves the rails with the barrel and spring loose inside it.
steps.quote: removed, slowly allow the slide to move forward against the spring pressure and pull it forward off the end of the frame (Picture 20).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 9, p.29

steps.title: ⛔ Ride the hammer down — never let it drop on a bare frame
steps.action: With the slide off, hold the grip in your firing hand. With the other hand hold the hammer, press the trigger, and ease the hammer forward under your thumb to decock the pistol.
steps.prose: ⛔ Staccato prints this as its own notice. With the slide off, nothing stops the hammer, so a hammer that falls freely strikes the frame, and that can damage the frame, the hammer, or both. Keep hold of it all the way down.
steps.quote: Once the slide is removed, while holding the grip with your firing hand, hold the hammer with your other hand and ride the hammer forward while pulling the trigger to decock the pistol.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 10, p.29
steps.warn: When your Staccato 2011 HD pistol is disassembled, never drop the hammer on the frame without the slide installed as this could damage the frame and/or the hammer.

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly: compress toward the muzzle, lift UP and out
steps.action: Turn the slide over. Push the recoil spring assembly slightly toward the muzzle end of the slide to take its end off the barrel, then lift it up and out of the slide.
steps.prose: ⛔ This is where the HD differs from the older Staccato strips. There is no paper-clip hook and no take-down tool. Compress it only a little, just enough for the end to clear, and keep your thumb on it as it comes up. It is a spring under load.
steps.quote: toward the muzzle end of the slide while pulling it up to remove it from the slide (Picture 21).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 11, p.29

steps.title: Reverse plug out of the slide
steps.action: With the recoil spring assembly out, take the reverse plug out of the slide.
steps.prose: The reverse plug only comes out once the spring assembly is out of the way, and it goes back in first during reassembly, before the spring assembly.
steps.quote: the reverse plug from the slide (Picture 22).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 12, p.29

steps.title: Barrel link FORWARD, barrel out the front
steps.action: Rotate the barrel link toward the muzzle, then pull the barrel straight out through the front of the slide.
steps.prose: Swing the link forward first. With the link standing up, the barrel will not pass through the front of the slide, and forcing it marks the slide. Pull it out straight.
steps.quote: Rotate the barrel link towards the muzzle and pull the barrel straight out through the front of the slide (Picture 23).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 13, p.29

steps.title: Weak-side slide stop lever: rotate UP, then out
steps.action: On the frame, rotate the weak-side slide stop lever up and remove it.
steps.prose: The HD has a second slide stop lever, on the other side of the frame. It does not push out like the first one. It rotates up and lifts off.
steps.quote: Once the slide has been removed, rotate the weak side slide stop lever up and remove it from the frame (Picture 24).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 14, p.30

steps.title: Field strip complete — and this is as far as it goes
steps.action: You now have the frame, the slide, the barrel, the recoil spring assembly, the reverse plug, and both slide stop levers. That is everything Staccato has the owner remove.
steps.prose: ⛔ Staccato stops here and says so in a printed warning. The firing pin, extractor and fire-control parts stay where they are. Further disassembly is for a Staccato 2011-Certified Armorer, and doing it yourself voids the warranty.
steps.quote: Never disassemble your Staccato 2011 HD pistol beyond what is described (Picture 25). Any additional disassembly should only be carried out by a Staccato 2011-Certified Armorer.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 10. Disassembly (Field Stripping), step 15, p.30

steps.title: Bore from the chamber end: patch, brush, patch until clean
steps.action: Always from the chamber end. Run a patch wet with solvent or CLP through several times. Then a bristle brush with cleaning product, followed by the rod. Then one wet patch, and look at it. Repeat brush and patch until a patch comes out clean, then finish with a patch lightly wet with oil or CLP.
steps.prose: Use patches and brushes sized for the pistol's caliber. Working from the chamber end pushes fouling out of the muzzle instead of back into the action. Staccato adds a step before you fire: dry patches through the bore until no oil comes out on them. If the pistol is going into storage, wait until you are ready to use it.
steps.quote: Using a bristled cleaning brush with cleaning product, run it through the barrel, from the chamber end (picture 26).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 11. Cleaning Instructions and Inspection, Barrel, step 2, p.33

steps.title: Rails, then the breech face with the muzzle DOWN
steps.action: Brush the slide rails where they meet the frame and patch them until clean. Then brush the breech face and under the extractor hook, holding the slide muzzle down, and patch until clean. Finish with any other dirt on the exposed slide.
steps.prose: Muzzle down is the point. Holding it that way lets debris fall away from the firing pin hole and the extractor instead of into them. ⛔ Keep oil out of the firing pin hole, and the breech face goes back together DRY. Oil there can reach the primer, and Staccato warns this can cause a misfire or a bullet stuck in the barrel.
steps.quote: Orient the slide with the muzzle down to push debris away from the firing pin hole and extractor.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 11. Cleaning Instructions and Inspection, Slide, step 3, p.34
steps.warn: Avoid placing lubricant or gun oil inside the firing pin hole.

steps.title: Frame rails, disconnector deck, slide stop notch, barrel-foot surfaces
steps.action: With a bristle brush and cleaning product, clean the frame rails where they meet the slide, the top of the disconnector deck and the slide stop notch. Last, clean the barrel foot's vertical and horizontal impact surfaces. Patch it all until a patch comes out clean, and check the frame for damage or unusual wear.
steps.prose: Staccato names the exact surfaces. The barrel-foot impact surfaces take a hit every shot, and the disconnector deck is where the slide rides over the trigger parts. Both collect powder residue.
steps.quote: Wet a bristle brush with cleaning product and thoroughly clean the rails on the frame where they meet the slide as well as the top of the disconnector deck and the slide stop notch.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 11. Cleaning Instructions and Inspection, Frame, step 1, p.35

steps.title: A drop each, by needle, in three places only
steps.action: With a needle applicator: a drop on the outside of the barrel, including the scallop cut and the locking lugs. A drop on the head of the disconnector inside the frame rails and on the recoil system's guide rod. A drop spread along the full length of each slide rail cut and onto the disconnector rail.
steps.prose: ⛔ Small amounts. Staccato says the HD is designed to run on a little lubrication. Too much collects unburned powder and dirt, and that slows the action down.
steps.quote: Using a needle applicator spread a drop of gun oil or lubricant along the entire length of each slide rail cut and onto the disconnector rail (Picture 31).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 11. Cleaning Instructions and Inspection, lubrication, step 3, p.35
steps.warn: Avoid over-lubricating, as excess lubricant can collect unburned powder and debris, hindering performance.

steps.title: ⛔ Firing pin block: the pin must NOT reach the breech face
steps.action: Holding the slide, press the firing pin block plunger several times and check it moves freely and drops back down. Then, with the plunger down, press the firing pin toward the breech face with a finger or a plastic tool, moderate force. It must not move past the plunger, and its tip must not come through the breech face. Then press the plunger in, press the firing pin again, and the tip should now come through.
steps.prose: This is the check Staccato asks for before reassembly. It is the owner's only look at the firing pin safety, because the slide is never stripped further. ⛔ If the pin comes through with the plunger down, the pistol does not get loaded or fired. It goes to Staccato or a certified armorer.
steps.quote: With the firing pin plunger in the downward position, ensure the firing pin cannot move forward of the firing pin plunger and that the firing pin does not protrude from the breach face (Picture 32).
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 11. Cleaning Instructions and Inspection, inspection 3, p.36

steps.title: Extractor, ejector, slide stop lever, magazines
steps.action: Check the extractor hook is clean and not bent or broken, and the ejector is not damaged. On the frame, lift the slide stop lever and let it go: it must snap back down. Check each magazine's feed lips and follower, and press the follower down to check it comes back up freely.
steps.prose: If the slide stop lever comes back slowly or stays up, Staccato's instruction is to contact Staccato or a certified armorer, not to oil it and try again. Spread feed lips cause feeding problems that look like a dirty pistol.
steps.quote: The slide stop lever should drop back with force into the frame.
steps.cite: STACCATO 2011® HD OWNER'S MANUAL — Owner's manual, 2025 (file name Staccato-HD_Owners-Manual 2025.pdf) — 11. Cleaning Instructions and Inspection, inspections 5–8, p.37

deepAbsentReason: The book ends at the field strip. Its DISASSEMBLY (FIELD STRIPPING) chapter (pp.27–30) stops at the slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly, reverse plug and the two slide stop levers. Its own warning on p.30 bars anything further: "Never disassemble your Staccato 2011 HD pistol beyond what is described (Picture 25). Any additional disassembly should only be carried out by a Staccato 2011-Certified Armorer." It adds that further disassembly voids the warranty unless a certified armorer does it. The firing pin, firing pin block and extractor appear only as checks done with the parts in place (pp.36–37). No owner-level procedure removes them.

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Patches and brushes sized for your caliber
Always from the CHAMBER end
Wet patch, bristle brush, wet patch, until a patch comes out clean
Outside of the barrel: wet brush, then a dry patch until clean
Finish with a patch lightly wet with gun oil or CLP
Before firing: dry patches until no oil comes out on them

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Slide rails where they meet the frame
Breech face and under the extractor hook, muzzle held DOWN
Any other dirt on the exposed slide
⛔ Never put oil inside the firing pin hole
⛔ Breech face goes back together DRY

cleaning.name: FRAME
tasks: Frame rails where they meet the slide
Top of the disconnector deck and the slide stop notch
Barrel foot vertical and horizontal impact surfaces
Patch until clean; check for damage or unusual wear

cleaning.name: LUBRICATION
tasks: Needle applicator: outside of the barrel, scallop cut and locking lugs
Disconnector head inside the frame rails, and the guide rod
Each slide rail cut, full length, and the disconnector rail
⛔ Do not over-lubricate: excess oil holds powder and debris
⛔ Magazines inside and out, DRY

reassembly: Barrel held by the muzzle, link swung down in line with the bore, and slid into the front of the slide.
Reverse plug into the slide, and the barrel link rotated up, square to the bore.

Recoil spring assembly into the slide, SMALL END toward the muzzle. Compress it slightly and press its end in behind the barrel foot. Hold it in place so it cannot fly out, and keep the link square to the bore.
Tip the frame forward so the firing pin lever is down. Start the slide onto the front of the frame rails and push it back until the barrel link lines up with the slide stop hole.
Holding the holes aligned, slide stop lever through the frame and the barrel link, then let the slide go forward slowly.
fncheck: Unloaded and proven, muzzle in a safe direction. TRIGGER TEST: press the trigger and hold it back. The hammer should drop. Still holding the trigger, pull the slide fully back and let it snap forward. Release the trigger, and it should reset forward. Repeat several times. SLIDE LOCK-OPEN TEST: insert an EMPTY magazine and pull the slide fully back. It should lock open. Repeat with each of your empty magazines. Staccato's instruction is that a pistol that dry-fires when its trigger safety should have stopped the trigger is not loaded or fired, and goes to Staccato or a certified armorer.
